Bʰréh₂ter, ḱléwos h₁ésti yód h₁éḱwos h₁ésti h₁n̥ h₂nérōm.
English: Brother, fame is what is heard among men.

Dómh₂m̥ h₁éymi.
English: I am going home.
H₁édmi h₁n̥ démh₂i téwe, h₁éḱe píbōmi.
Ḱléwos h₁ésti yód h₁éḱwos h₁ésti h₁n̥ h₂nérōm.
H₁éy, ph₂tḗr, h₂érh₃trom kapyō, dwóh₁ gʷówh₁e-kʷe h₂érh₃trōy yunǵmi.
Dawn, the daughter of Sky, was shining.
The sun's horses stand in the sky.
The sun's daughter stood on the chariot.
Go, you two of the good horses!
He who slays, they do not slay him.
I slay the serpent with a weapon.
He gave a name to his son.
May blood grow together with blood for you.
We invoke the giver of good things.
I praise the great Sky Father.
You hold the earth and the sky.
The daughter of the sky is born.
